title: EARLIER in a calculated column: running total of the rows up to the current value
query: DEFINE COLUMN Product[Running Price] = SUMX ( FILTER ( Product, Product[Price] <= EARLIER ( Product[Price] ) ), Product[Price] )
EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS ( Product, "Product", Product[Product], "Running", Product[Running Price] ) ORDER BY [Product]

source.quote: Returns the current value of the specified column in an outer evaluation pass of the mentioned column.
source.supports: EARLIER reads the row of the calculated column while FILTER scans the table again

source.quote: EARLIER is mostly used in the context of calculated columns.
source.supports: the calculated column supplies the outer row context

derivation: Prices: Lock 10, Helmet 20, Scooter 50, Bike 100. Sum of the prices up to the current one: Lock 10; Helmet 10 + 20 = 30; Scooter 30 + 50 = 80; Bike 80 + 100 = 180. The sum of a fixed decimal column is a fixed decimal.
